order-procedure.title: How to order
order-procedure.html:
Order on the website

  1. Open the product, choose the colour / size / model and press Order now.
  2. Enter your name, mobile number and full address, choose Inside or Outside Dhaka, and press Confirm order.
  3. Our team will call you to confirm. You will get an SMS with a tracking link.
  4. Pay the rider when the parcel arrives (cash on delivery).

Other ways

Call or WhatsApp us on 01338-325365 and we will place the order for you.

delivery-rules.title: Delivery policy
delivery-rules.html:
• Inside Dhaka: ৳60, usually 1–2 working days.
  • Outside Dhaka: ৳120, usually 2–4 working days.
  • Parcels are sent with trusted couriers (Steadfast and others). You can follow the courier's live status from the tracking link in your SMS.
  • Delivery can take longer during holidays, strikes or bad weather.

return-policy.title: Return & replacement
return-policy.html:
• Check the product in front of the delivery person.
  • Damaged, wrong or different-model products are replaced free if you tell us within 3 days of delivery.
  • Unused products in their original box can be returned within 3 days; the customer pays the return delivery charge.
  • Refunds are sent by bKash or Nagad within 3–5 working days after we receive the product.

terms-&-conditions.title: Terms & conditions
terms-&-conditions.html: Our team calls every customer to confirm the order. Orders we cannot confirm may be put on hold or cancelled. Colours can look slightly different on different screens. Prices, offers and stock can change without notice.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.html: We use your name, mobile number and address only to process and deliver your order and to contact you about it. We never sell your information. Only the details needed for delivery are shared with the courier company.

about-us.title: About us
about-us.html: Smart China Gallery is an online shop in New Paltan, Dhaka for gadgets, electronics, winter gadgets, smart-home, car & bike accessories, personal care, fashion and home & kitchen products. We deliver all over Bangladesh with cash on delivery.
